label: copy-phase echo of c (late recall) when r/f/o is output now or next
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost exclusively (94% of mass) on steps whose fed-back input is the letter c; never in the original or delimiter phase. Mostly at recall_idx 3-5 (c at original positions 2-4), near-silent for recall_idx <= 2. Magnitude is gated by what comes next: strongest (top examples ~0.8-1.0 of max) when the token being output now is r, f or o (lift 13x/10x/7.5x), weaker when r/f/o is the next output, and weak or zero for c followed by other tokens (input c alone has precision only 0.11). Minor activations on inputs r/o right after the c. Predicate input c & recall_idx>=3 & r/f/o output now or next: dev P 0.68 R 0.61 F1 0.64, mass recall 0.78. Widening the lookahead to 3 outputs or adding p/z raises mass recall (to 0.83/0.90) but lowers precision. Does not fire on c in the original phase or on other letters in general.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=c (+7.65), phase=2 & in_tok=r (+6.00), phase=2 & in_tok=o (+4.83), in_tok=c (+4.26), phase=2 & out_tok=o (+3.98), next_out=r (+3.17). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.35), recall_idx=1 (-4.15), prev_tok=<DEL> (-4.15), out_tok=b (-3.59).
